title: Society: sentence adverbs
summary: Use the English meaning and Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase.

s01.sentenceGloss: It is nine o’clock, but school has already started.

s02.sentenceGloss: I have only one question, not several.

s03.sentenceGloss: I gladly help you; I do so with pleasure.

s04.sentenceGloss: She says that the school is not closed.
s04.note: Inte precedes the finite verb är in the att clause.

s05.sentenceGloss: We need both teachers and pupils.

s06.sentenceGloss: I have neither a car nor a bicycle.

s07.sentenceGloss: We will go to the meeting even if it should rain.
s07.note: Även om introduces a hypothetical concession.

s08.sentenceGloss: He helps out although he is tired.
s08.note: Trots att introduces a factual concession.
